title: Kestrel and the Weather
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Astrid Vasquez, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
